'''Stalpaac''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] elder of legend on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Legend stated that Stalpaac saved [[Urothko]] from a [[Graaa'shad]], at the risk of Stalpaac's own life. Urothko responded to Stalpaac's rescue by swearing the first [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]].<ref name="TLCSB" />
